scope: Consolidate all evaluation findings against this branch; repair demonstrated current failures and bounded efficiency/recovery issues. No model runs or GitHub writes.

steps.name: Git checkpoints and bounded prompt context
Explicit recovery of suggestion setup checks
Focused tests, full backend/frontend checks, final ledger

issues.title: Configuration trust misses ignored changes/deletion
checks: tests/test_owner_trust.py: ignored additions/edits, last ignored file deletion, tracked deletion, and pre-launch enforcement

issues.title: Uncertain reply rewritten during reassociation
Restored general feedback stays outside Attention
Replanning leaves dangling dependency before adoption
issues.disposition: Retain complete/skipped tasks and original plan history; remove dependencies on replaced task IDs before later adoption.

issues.title: Closed PR accepts next reply POST after refresh
Preflight failure erases ready verification eligibility
issues.disposition: Only a preflight failure after source, settings, discussion and trust checks preserves an unchanged ready batch.

issues.title: Own published reply invalidates remaining replies and batch
Unrelated skip bypasses interrupted-task adoption gate
issues.disposition: Skips must cover all interrupted tasks; unknown interrupted stages and combined repairs require explicit adoption.

issues.title: Adoption removes queued task initial fixer stage
Unrelated shared Git config change triggers integrity recovery
issues.disposition: Retain the conservative shared Git administration integrity check. No safe distinction between unrelated and relevant changes was established.

issues.title: Fork repository identity breaks remembered toolkit routing
Final-review prompt duplicates accumulated diff
issues.disposition: Omit task_diff only when byte-identical to batch_diff; preserve distinct empty task diffs.

issues.title: Network owner operations lack frontend cancellation ID
Replanning retains unavailable feedback and revives explicit skips
issues.disposition: Explicit skips remain historical tasks across replanning and do not stale the active feedback set.

issues.title: Fix at root heading includes non-attention History items
Ignored file paths are duplicated into state and model contexts
issues.disposition: Retain ignored files on disk; store a count and a 20-path diagnostic sample, including legacy context compaction.

issues.title: Dirty submodule contents are invisible to checkpoint identities
issues.disposition: Reject dirty initialized submodules before checkpointing because a superproject tree cannot capture their uncommitted contents.

issues.title: Configured push destination can become stale
issues.disposition: No demonstrated current failure or safe automatic rewrite of user-managed push configuration. Reproduce against current branch before changing behavior.

issues.title: Automatic repair proceeds despite reviewer clarification outcomes
issues.disposition: Legacy clarify outcomes block both task and combined automatic repairs.

issues.title: Deleted feedback aborts commit association for surviving items
issues.disposition: Preserve deleted-feedback commit associations as history and report them without aborting surviving replies.

issues.title: Fresh checkpoint indexes may rehash unchanged tracked files
issues.disposition: Fresh index construction is source-visible; repository-scale latency and a safe caching strategy have not been established.

issues.title: Failed checkpoints allegedly accept unreviewed final work
issues.disposition: Historical adjudication did not establish the claimed defect; retain evidence and require a new concrete reproduction before repair.

issues.title: Explicit recovery mutations persist before later validation fails
issues.disposition: Historical adjudication did not establish the claimed defect; retain evidence and require a new concrete reproduction before repair.

issues.title: Repeated freshness checks allegedly constitute a demonstrated performance defect
issues.disposition: Historical adjudication did not establish the claimed defect; retain evidence and require a new concrete reproduction before repair.

issues.title: Owner auth preflight allegedly accepts terminal provider failures
issues.disposition: Historical adjudication did not establish the claimed defect; retain evidence and require a new concrete reproduction before repair.

issues.title: Recovered verification setup failure still blocks suggestion acceptance
checks: tests/test_suggestions.py: explicit setup failure supersession, rejection of executed check failures and invalid links
issues.disposition: Add explicit successful rerun links for setup failures only. Keep all evidence; executed failing checks and unclassified legacy failures remain blockers.

issues.title: Reopening an owner buffer discards the freshly loaded view
Provider command patterns may permit remote push variants
issues.disposition: Command-pattern concern lacks an executed current-provider reproduction. Do not claim sandbox bypass or weaken policy without evidence.

issues.title: Duplicated task and combined repair policy allegedly loses required evidence
issues.disposition: Historical adjudication did not establish the claimed defect; retain evidence and require a new concrete reproduction before repair.

issues.title: Failed combined repair resumes without explicit adoption
issues.disposition: Persist pending combined repairs before invocation; detect legacy failed attempts and require adoption before review resumes.

additional_improvements.change: Request focused executable reproductions for stateful recovery claims when supported, inspect surrounding orchestration, and state per-finding limitations when relying on inspection. Read-only source alone does not establish that scratch tests are impossible.

delivery: Implemented and validated on the original feature branch; no push, GitHub writes, or additional model runs.
